An '''electrum mattock''' is the [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] [[mattock]], made by smithing a [[Diamond Hoe|diamond hoe]] with [[Electrum Alloy|electrum alloy]]. It mines at speed 10 and has 3000 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/electrum_mattock.json}}</ref>

As a [[mattock]], it works as both a shovel and a hoe, at a lower mining speed than the electrum shovel or hoe.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

This upgrade needs a [[Smithing Upgrade Template|smithing upgrade template]] in the template slot. The recipe matches the base by item ID, so a [[Diamond Mattock|diamond mattock]] works as the base as well as a diamond hoe. Without the template, the same base and alloy make an [[Electrum Hoe|electrum hoe]] instead.

Enchantments already on the base item are kept. Where the base and the new item share an enchantment, the higher level is used.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The loot table <code>matcha:equipment/electrum/mattock</code> gives the item exactly as crafted; it is used by <code>/loot</code> and by the [[Updating items|item update system]].

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines both shovel and hoe blocks at speed 10.

In Matcha Flavoured, hoes also mine wool, carpets, glow lichen and [[Phosphor lamps|phosphor lamps]] quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/hoe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===

It deals 3 damage with an attack speed of 3.

=== Intrinsics ===

* {{G|Fortune}} II: raises the drops of ores and other Fortune-affected blocks exactly like Fortune; it is the only way to reach Fortune III.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/diamond_ore.json}}</ref>
* [[Warding|{{G|Warding}} 1]]

The intrinsics are stored on the item and applied when it enters an inventory. See [[Electrum equipment]] for how the tier's intrinsics work together.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Diamond|blocks of diamond}}. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Adamant Alloy|adamant alloy]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/netherite_ingot_from_blasting_netherite_materials.json}}</ref>

Because electrum equipment uses the same item IDs as adamant, the recipe returns an adamant alloy, not electrum.

=== Trading ===
An apprentice-level [[Weaponsmith|weaponsmith]] takes it in exchange for one [[Electrum Alloy|electrum alloy]], so the alloy can be reused.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/electrum_mattock.json}}</ref>

== Notes ==
* The 1.12.2 release notes say Warding was removed from electrum tools, but the electrum mattock still carries {{G|Warding}} 1.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/electrum_mattock.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.4-alpha|Added translation support for all armor and tools. Fixed electrum tools and weapons, whose Warding did not work.}}
{{History line|1.03|Electrum alloy now needs a [[Divine Fragment|divine fragment]], like adamant, and has an enchantment glint.}}
{{History line|1.10|Alloy equipment can be traded to a [[Weaponsmith|weaponsmith]] for its alloy, so players can rebuild old items with updated stats. Buffed electrum, and made the set bonus clearer.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Smithing no longer needs a base-metal ingot in the template slot; the slot is left empty. Smithing now keeps the enchantments already on the item. Added the "Repaired with" tooltip, and repair materials were made consistent across all alloys. Electrum became the only source of Fortune III, and it can only be repaired with blocks of diamond.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older items can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>. Electrum equipment no longer burns in fire or lava, and electrum armor counts as armor that piglins accept. Warding was removed from electrum tools so that they focus on Fortune.}}
}}
